provide financial statements and reporting.
provide loan and credit facilities.

differences.heading: Key Differences
differences.subtitle: What makes Jabi Union stand out
items: Operates strictly based on the plans and democratic decisions of member primary cooperatives.
Member cooperatives are the direct owners of all the Union's assets.
Provides loans at lower interest rates (8% – 14%) as determined by the general assembly.
Distributes annual net profits back to member cooperatives as dividends.
Provides professional training and technical support to cooperative leaders and employees.
Tailors all operations and financial services directly to member needs.
Pays higher savings interest rates (7.5%) compared to conventional financial institutions.
Serves all community segments, ensuring access for low-income individuals without heavy collateral.
Offers competitive time/fixed-deposit interest rates ranging from 8% to 11%.

items.question: Who can access Jabi Cooperative services?
items.answer: Any registered member of Jabi Cooperatives Saving & Credit Union in good standing can access our full range of services.

items.question: What are the requirements for a loan?
items.answer: Applicants need an active membership account, valid identification, proof of income or collateral, and a completed loan application form.

items.question: How long does loan approval take?
items.answer: Most loan applications are reviewed and approved within a few business days after all required documents are submitted.

items.question: Can I apply for more than one loan?
items.answer: Members may hold multiple loan products subject to eligibility review and their overall repayment capacity.

items.question: How can I repay my loan?
items.answer: Repayments can be made at any branch, through payroll deduction, or via our mobile banking channels.

items.question: How can I become a member of Jabi Cooperatives S.C.U?
items.answer: Visit any branch with a valid ID and complete the membership application form. Our staff will guide you through account opening and the initial savings deposit.

items.question: What are the requirements for a loan?
items.answer: You need an active membership account, valid identification, proof of income or collateral, and a completed loan application form.

items.question: How can I check my account balance?
items.answer: You can check your balance at any branch, through our mobile banking service, or by calling our customer service line.

items.question: What are your interest rates on savings and loans?
items.answer: Interest rates vary by product and are reviewed periodically. Please contact a branch or our support line for the most current rates.

items.question: How can I update my account information?
items.answer: Visit your nearest branch with valid identification to update your account details, or contact customer support for guidance.
